summary: Full backend + frontend regression for Machine Workshop (new schema: slot_id/slot_label, location/landmark; auth cookie; settings/slots/bookings). Rewrote /app/backend/tests/test_workshop_api.py to match the new booking payload and added coverage for /api/config, /api/slots/available, /api/slots (create/toggle/delete + auth guards), /api/settings (auth guard, put persist, holiday_mode blocks, is_available=False blocks), /api/bookings (create, list+search, stats, status flow Accepted→In Progress→Completed, Rejected, invalid status 400, nonexistent 404, closed-slot rejected, capacity enforced). Fixed xdist race by consolidating settings-mutating tests into one class so LoadScopeScheduling pins them to one worker. 25/25 pytest passed. Frontend E2E via Playwright verified: Home hero/book-now/call-now/6 brand-cards/3 reviews; /book form submit → booking-success; unauth /admin → /login; login → dashboard; Bookings search filters (27→1), Accept button flow works; Slots tab add/toggle/delete works (via API-confirmed persistence); Settings max_bookings_per_slot persists after onBlur+reload=4; Holiday-mode ON → /book closed-message + / closed-banner shown; toggling OFF restores form; logout redirects to /login.

ui_bugs.issue: Every mutation (addSlot, toggleSlot, removeSlot, saveSettings) calls loadAll() which sets loading=true → the entire Tabs container is unmounted and remounted with defaultValue='bookings'. Result: after toggling a slot ON/OFF, deleting a slot, or saving settings, the user is thrown back to the Bookings tab. Fix: don't gate the whole dashboard on loading; either scope loading to per-section, or make Tabs controlled with a persisted active tab, or refresh only the affected slice (setSlots/setSettings) without flipping global loading.

action_items: Fix AdminDashboard tab-reset UX bug: mutations shouldn't unmount Tabs (loading=true bounces user to Bookings). Make Tabs controlled or use per-section loading flags.
critical_code_review_comments: CORS still allows only single FRONTEND_URL; preview + production Vercel URLs would need a list/regex.
AdminDashboard.jsx: loadAll() flipping global loading=true remounts the entire Tabs and resets active tab to defaultValue — noticeable regression for any user interacting with Slots or Settings.

server.py DELETE /api/slots/{id} does not clean up bookings still referencing the deleted slot_id; those bookings become orphaned (slot_label is still stored so listing works, but slot integrity is lost).

test_workshop_api.py had to be rewritten because previous tests used the old schema (place/preferred_date) — main agent should update generator/tests together next time.
pytest.ini forces -n 2 loadscope; any two test classes that mutate shared settings will race. Consolidated them into TestBookings class as a workaround; a filelock-based fixture would be cleaner.

Note pytest.ini forces xdist -n 2 loadscope; keep all settings-mutating tests in the same class or they will race. Frontend has a known UX issue where any admin mutation kicks the user back to the Bookings tab (loading=true unmounts Tabs).
rca of the issue: AdminDashboard.jsx line 119: `if (loading || !settings) return <Loader />` unmounts the entire <Tabs defaultValue='bookings'> subtree every time loadAll() runs. Since Tabs is uncontrolled with defaultValue='bookings', when it remounts the active tab resets. Repro: login → click Service Slots tab → toggle any slot ON/OFF → UI jumps back to Bookings tab. Mitigation: (a) make Tabs controlled via useState-tracked active tab, (b) don't set loading=true on subsequent loadAll() calls, or (c) update only the affected slice (setSlots / setSettings) without triggering a full-screen loader.
